parameters.help_en:
The owner of the resource share.

Self: Queries the principals that are associated with the resource shares you created.

OtherAccounts: Queries the resource shares that other accounts created and shared with you, and the owners of these resource shares
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元归属者。

Self：查询您创建的共享单元中，关联的资源使用者列表。
OtherAccounts：查询其他账号创建的共享单元中，您作为资源使用者的共享单元及共享单元拥有者列表
parameters.name: resource_owner

parameters.help_en:
The type of the shared resource.

For more information about the resource types that can be shared, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html
parameters.help_zh:
共享资源类型。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared resource
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the shared resource
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and retrieve the remaining entries
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of resource shares.

The value of N can be from 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 resource share IDs
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享单元
parameters.name: resource_share_ids

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and retrieve the remaining entries
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the principal was associated with the resource share
CreateTime.description_zh: 关联资源使用者的时间

External.description_en:
Indicates whether the principal is an account outside the resource directory. Valid values:

true

false
External.description_zh:
资源使用者是否为资源目录外账号。取值：

true：资源目录外账号。
false：资源目录内账号

ResourceShareId.description_en: The ID of the resource share

TargetId.description_en:
The ID of the principal or the resource owner. Valid values:

If you set `ResourceOwner` to `Self`, this parameter is the ID of the principal.

If you set `ResourceOwner` to `OtherAccounts`, this parameter is the ID of the resource owner
TargetId.description_zh:
资源使用者ID或资源所有者ID。取值：

当`ResourceOwner`为`Self`时，该参数为资源使用者ID。
当`ResourceOwner`为`OtherAccounts`时，该参数为资源所有者ID

TargetProperty.description_en:
The properties of the principal. For example, the time period for resource sharing.

This parameter is returned only when the principal is an Alibaba Cloud service
TargetProperty.description_zh:
资源使用者属性。例如：资源共享的时间段。
仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时返回该参数

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the association with the principal was updated
UpdateTime.description_zh: 更新关联资源使用者的时间
